# Subtlegold

Subtlegold applies a subtle gold visual style with matching Dark and Light modes. The editor, panes and UI elements are restyled together, and the recorded description names no further options.

![Subtlegold screenshot](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/kartik-karz/subtlegold-obsidian/HEAD/subtlegold-theme.png)

```cue
theme: {
    name:   "Subtlegold"
    author: "kartik-karz"
    repo:   "kartik-karz/subtlegold-obsidian"
    slug:   "subtlegold"

    html_url:       "https://community.obsidian.md/themes/subtlegold"
    github_url:     "https://github.com/kartik-karz/subtlegold-obsidian"
    screenshot_url: "https://raw.githubusercontent.com/kartik-karz/subtlegold-obsidian/HEAD/subtlegold-theme.png"

    modes: ["dark", "light"]
    about: "Apply a subtle gold visual style to Obsidian with matching Dark and Light modes. Restyle the editor, panes, and UI elements for a cohesive, understated appearance."
}
```
